card.name: "At any time" and onset of reactions
card.fires_on: The word "time" in "can occur at any time" and the word "onset" in "the onset of the reaction", in warnings about when adverse reactions begin.

modes.label: At any time
modes.description: The word "time" after "at any" in statements that a reaction can occur at any time after starting treatment.
modes.example: Immune-mediated adverse reactions can occur at any<< time>> after starting treatment with a PD-1

modes.label: Onset of reaction
modes.description: The word "onset" after "the" when describing when a reaction usually begins.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning where the text says when a reaction can start, such as at any time or the onset.
